questions.question: Explain non-verbal communication and illustrate it with examples from daily life.
questions.solution_html:
• Non-verbal communication conveys messages without words, using body language, gestures
  • facial expressions, posture, eye contact, and proxemics. For instance, a smile indicates
  • friendliness, while a frown shows displeasure. Nodding communicates agreement, and a firm
  • handshake conveys confidence. Eye contact signals attention and honesty, while avoiding it
  • may suggest discomfort. Posture reflects attitude; standing straight shows confidence, while
  • slouching indicates disinterest. Touch, such as a pat on the back, communicates support.
  • Even silence can express thoughtfulness or disagreement. Non-verbal cues complement
  • verbal messages and are essential in daily interactions to express emotions and intentions
  • clearly.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: clearly.

questions.question: What is the difference between traditional and digital mass media?
questions.solution_html:
• Traditional mass media includes newspapers, radio, and television, which deliver messages in
  • a one-way format to passive audiences. It primarily informs or entertains but offers limited
  • interaction. Digital mass media, such as social media platforms, websites, and streaming
  • services, enables two-way communication, allowing users to respond, comment, share, and
  • create content. Digital media is faster, accessible globally, and interactive, while traditional
  • media often follows scheduled programming and localized reach. Additionally, digital
  • platforms track engagement, allowing personalized experiences. The key difference lies in
  • interactivity, accessibility, speed, and the level of audience participation between the two.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: interactivity, accessibility, speed, and the level of audience participation between the two.

questions.question: Describe the functions of mass media with suitable examples.
questions.solution_html:
• The media plays a crucial role in society by informing people about current events
  • educating through formal and informal learning, and entertaining audiences via films
  • shows, and music. It also persuades and influences public opinion through advertisements
  • campaigns, and editorials. As a watchdog, media monitors governments and institutions
  • exposing corruption and safeguarding public interest, which is why it is called the Fourth
  • Estate in a democracy. Media aids socialization by shaping values, norms, and behavior, and
  • supports cultural transmission by preserving traditions and introducing global cultures.
  • Finally, it acts as a catalyst for development, promoting health, education, awareness, and
  • social progress.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: social progress.

questions.question: Write a short note on the importance of the effect component in Lasswell’s model. Part D ESSAY
questions.solution_html:
• The effect component in Lasswell’s communication model examines the impact of a message
  • on its audience. It evaluates whether communication has influenced knowledge, attitudes
  • beliefs, or behaviour. By measuring effects, communicators can assess the success of
  • campaigns, advertisements, or public messages. For example, a health awareness campaign
  • can be evaluated by changes in vaccination rates or public awareness. The effect component
  • also guides future communication strategies, helping refine content, methods, and channels
  • for better results. Understanding effects ensures that communication is purposeful, targeted
  • and capable of achieving desired outcomes in social, educational, or political contexts.
  • ESSAY
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: ESSAY

questions.question: Explain the concept of dysfunctions of media.
